content: If you miss a dose of your medication, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Different brands of this medication may have specific storage requirements. Refer to the product packaging for detailed storage instructions or consult your pharmacist. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. The information provided here was last updated in September 2024. It is important to note that this summary does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific situation. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your individual health needs. Dronabinol is used to treat nausea and vomiting caused by cancer chemotherapy, particularly when other medications have not been effective. It is also prescribed to manage appetite loss and weight loss in patients with HIV infection. Before starting dronabinol, read the patient information leaflet provided by your pharmacist. Take this medication by mouth as directed by your doctor. If you are using it to control nausea and vomiting, it is typically taken 4 to 6 times daily. If it is being used to treat appetite loss, it is usually taken twice daily, before lunch and dinner. The dosage is determined based on your medical condition and response to treatment. Do not increase your dose, take it more frequently, or use it for a longer duration than prescribed. If you suddenly stop taking this medication, you may experience withdrawal symptoms such as irritability, difficulty sleeping, restlessness, hot flashes, or diarrhea. To minimize withdrawal risk, your doctor may gradually reduce your dose. Withdrawal is more likely if you have been using dronabinol for a long time or at high doses. While this medication is beneficial for many, it may sometimes lead to addiction, especially if you have a history of substance use disorder. Take this medication exactly as prescribed to reduce the risk of addiction. Common side effects of dronabinol include dizziness, drowsiness, confusion, a feeling of being high, an exaggerated sense of well-being, lightheadedness, nausea, vomiting, or stomach/abdominal pain. These effects may occur as your body adjusts to the medication. Remember that your doctor has prescribed this medication because they believe the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare. If you experience any concerning side effects, contact your doctor immediately. Before taking dronabinol, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, marijuana (cannabis), or any other substances. This product may contain inactive ingredients, such as sesame oil, which can cause allergic reactions or other issues. This medication may cause dizziness, drowsiness, or impair your judgment. Alcohol or marijuana use can worsen these effects. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or performing tasks requiring alertness until you can do so safely. Refrain from consuming alcoholic beverages. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant. You should not become pregnant while using dronabinol, as it may harm an unborn baby. This medication also passes into breast milk and may harm a nursing infant. Breastfeeding is not recommended while using this medication. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Check the labels of all your medications, such as allergy or cough-and-cold products, as they may contain ingredients that cause drowsiness. In the event of an overdose, if someone has serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Do not share this medication with others. It has been prescribed for your specific condition and may not be suitable for others. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and consult them for any questions or concerns about your treatment.
